scientific_integrity: The claimed all-parameter result is established by a local dual-face classification, explicit elementary collapses, and integral Alexander duality. Finite Smith-form calculations are corroboration, not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordinary three-cut complexes of the stated reflected-seam grids with both parameters at least five; does not classify the homotopy type of the original cut complex. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Two-torsion in ordinary three-cut complexes of Klein-bottle square grids
